mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fortune_results (member_id, slug, payment_id, name, status, input_json) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{slug}, #{paymentId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{inputJson}) ON CONFLICT (payment_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.slug, f.title AS title, r.name, r.status, r.created_at FROM fortune_results r LEFT JOIN fortunes f ON f.slug = r.slug WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
